title: Classify reviewer RCPT 451 enhanced status and safe reason without publishing raw SMTP or sending mail
acceptance: the detail workflow is owner-only on release issue 3072 and uses the exact command /production p0-reviewer-smtp-451-detail current-main
the wrapper pins the already merged no-mail reviewer SMTP stage probe by exact Git blob d4fade37d316e15e9d1bc33fa2fde89929f7db55
only a RUNNER_TEMP copy is transformed and its embedded Python is compiled locally before REG.RU access
the transformed probe remains bounded through RCPT TO followed by RSET and QUIT and contains no SMTP DATA send
the raw SMTP response remains only inside the production process and is reduced to numeric SMTP code, enhanced status and a fixed whitelist reason class
published reason classes are limited to RATE_LIMIT, GREYLIST_TEMPORARY, ANTI_ABUSE_POLICY, DESTINATION_ROUTING_TEMPFAIL, RECIPIENT_TEMPFAIL, TEMPORARY_POLICY, UNCLASSIFIED_451 or NONE
reviewer address, sender, credentials and raw SMTP response are never published
no reset replay, database write, password/MFA/session change, deployment or container lifecycle mutation is allowed
production mutation is NONE and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
